# Keyboard shortcuts

Every binding in Kimo, from the same table the app's **Keyboard shortcuts** sheet renders (open it with `⌘/` on macOS, `Ctrl+/` elsewhere, from **File › Help** in the app, or from the desktop app's native **Help** menu). On Windows and Linux, `Ctrl` replaces `⌘` and `Alt` replaces `⌥`; both modifiers are accepted on every platform. `⌫` is Backspace or Delete.

> [!NOTE]
> Single-key tool shortcuts (`V`, `F`, `R` …) and canvas commands need the canvas focused: they don't fire while you type in a field or in the agent composer.

## Tools

| Action | macOS | Windows · Linux |
|---|---|---|
| Move | `V` | `V` |
| Frame | `F` | `F` |
| Rectangle | `R` | `R` |
| Ellipse | `O` | `O` |
| Text | `T` | `T` |
| Pen | `P` | `P` |
| Note | `N` | `N` |
| Prompt | `⇧P` | `Shift+P` |
| Image | `⇧⌘K` | `Ctrl+Shift+K` |
| Icon picker | `I` | `I` |
| Hand | `H` | `H` |

## File

| Action | macOS | Windows · Linux |
|---|---|---|
| New file | `⌘N` | `Ctrl+N` |
| Open… | `⌘O` | `Ctrl+O` |
| Save | `⌘S` | `Ctrl+S` |
| Save as… | `⇧⌘S` | `Ctrl+Shift+S` |
| Settings | `⌘,` | `Ctrl+,` |

## Edit

| Action | macOS | Windows · Linux |
|---|---|---|
| Undo | `⌘Z` | `Ctrl+Z` |
| Redo | `⇧⌘Z` or `⌘Y` | `Ctrl+Shift+Z` or `Ctrl+Y` |
| Duplicate | `⌘D` | `Ctrl+D` |
| Group | `⌘G` | `Ctrl+G` |
| Delete | `⌫` | `⌫` |
| Nudge 1 px · 10 px | `←↑→↓` or `⇧←` | `←↑→↓` or `Shift+←` |
| Rename layer | `F2` | `F2` |

## Selection & layers

| Action | macOS | Windows · Linux |
|---|---|---|
| Select children | `↵` | `↵` |
| Select parent / deselect | `Esc` | `Esc` |
| Add to selection | `⇧ click` | `Shift click` |
| Select inside group | `⌘ click` | `Ctrl click` |
| Hide / show | `⇧⌘H` | `Ctrl+Shift+H` |
| Lock / unlock | `⇧⌘L` | `Ctrl+Shift+L` |

## Components & variables

| Action | macOS | Windows · Linux |
|---|---|---|
| Create component | `⌥⌘K` | `Ctrl+Alt+K` |
| Detach instance | `⌥⌘B` | `Ctrl+Alt+B` |
| Go to main component | `⌥↵` | `Alt+↵` |
| Variables | `⇧⌘V` | `Ctrl+Shift+V` |

## View

| Action | macOS | Windows · Linux |
|---|---|---|
| Zoom in | `⌘=` or `=` | `Ctrl+=` or `=` |
| Zoom out | `⌘−` or `−` | `Ctrl+−` or `−` |
| Zoom to 100 % | `⌘0` or `⇧0` | `Ctrl+0` or `Shift+0` |
| Zoom to fit | `⇧1` | `Shift+1` |
| Zoom to selection | `⇧2` | `Shift+2` |
| Pan | `Space drag` | `Space drag` |

## Agent & text

| Action | macOS | Windows · Linux |
|---|---|---|
| Ask Kimo | `⌘K` | `Ctrl+K` |
| Link… (text selected) | `⌘K` | `Ctrl+K` |
| Italic (text selected) | `⌘I` | `Ctrl+I` |
| Finish editing text | `⌘↵` or `Esc` | `Ctrl+↵` or `Esc` |

## Conflicts

| Action | macOS | Windows · Linux |
|---|---|---|
| Next conflict | `⌘'` | `Ctrl+'` |
| Previous conflict | `⇧⌘'` | `Ctrl+Shift+'` |

## Help

| Action | macOS | Windows · Linux |
|---|---|---|

## In a mode

These keys only apply while the mode is active, so the sheet doesn't list them.

### Pen

| Action | macOS | Windows · Linux |
|---|---|---|
| Finish path | `↵` | `↵` |
| Remove last point | `⌫` | `⌫` |

### Path editing

| Action | macOS | Windows · Linux |
|---|---|---|
| Exit path editing | `↵` | `↵` |
| Delete points | `⌫` | `⌫` |

### Image placement

| Action | macOS | Windows · Linux |
|---|---|---|
| Cancel placement | `Esc` | `Esc` |

### While dragging

| Action | macOS | Windows · Linux |
|---|---|---|
| Cancel drag | `Esc` | `Esc` |
